The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty. Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $13.15 (Tranche 1), $12.35 (Tranche 2), and $11.41 (Tranche 3).
